name: io.github.mthines/lorekit
title: LoreKit
description: Shared memory for coding agents: lessons learned from failures, recalled by scope.

environmentVariables.name: LOREKIT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: `local` keeps lessons as markdown on disk with no account; `remote` uses the hosted store

environmentVariables.name: LOREKIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LoreKit API token (lk_rw_…), only for remote mode

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer lk_rw_… token from lorekit.io → Connect your agent
